package: ChatGPT Mac dot Computers connection diagnostics

collection.method: Read-only app/process metadata and bounded review of the selected clean pre-task log window; live post-cutoff records excluded; no raw log lines copied; no user action/reproduction.

live_processes.name: SkyComputerUseService
live_processes.scope_note: Process presence does not establish that this component owns dot Computers.

reported_dot_ui.provenance: Parent-reported current UI state; not directly captured by this writer.
previous_messages: 无法更新远程控制状态

computer_use_attempt.provenance: Parent-reported fresh CUA attempt during this task; exact timestamp not provided.
computer_use_attempt.message: Computer Use is not allowed to use app com.openai.codex for safety reasons.
computer_use_attempt.macos_permission_conclusion: CANNOT_CONFIRM; tool safety denial is not evidence that macOS denied permission.

clean_pre_diagnostic_log.review_result: No dot-specific state, request body, response status/error, client identifier, service request ID, or handshake/close result could be identified.
clean_pre_diagnostic_log.basename_redaction_note: Only UUID/session identifier segment redacted; remaining original basename unchanged.

excluded_live_task_log.reason: Live task log grew during this diagnosis; session-style identifiers overlapped the active diagnostic context. Rows may be self-generated chat/tool/session instrumentation; exact event type and service provenance CANNOT_CONFIRM.

unclassified_identifiers_from_excluded_r.status: excluded as potentially self-generated task/session metadata
